title: The fight over Flock and other ALPRs
summary: Earlier this year, Amazon-owned Ring canceled a partnership with Flock after online backlash. Following intense backlash to its partnership with Flock Safety , a surveillance technology company that works with law enforcement agencies, Ring has announced it is canceling the integration.
